article.title: Columbus DSA stands in Solidarity with Ilhan Omar
article.author: Columbus DSA
article.content: The Columbus chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) extends our full support to Representative Ilhan Omar in the face of racist and xenophobic campaigns against her by the Trump Administration and the fascist right wing. The targeting of Rep. Omar escalated on Monday, October 12, with the unprecedented raid of her Washington, DC home by the Trump Administration’s Department of Justice (DOJ). The DOJ has claimed that it is investigating possible “immigration fraud” committed by Rep. Omar, a baseless conspiracy theory for which no evidence has ever been produced, even after years of targeting by the far right. But the real aim of the assault is clear: to vilify and silence Rep. Omar in the weeks before the midterm elections, create a pretext for efforts to deport her, and stoke further xenophobia and Islamophobia against Somali communities across the country. The Trump Administration’s campaign of terror against Rep. Omar and our Somali neighbors, from ICE’s “Operation Metro Surge” in Minneapolis to its “Operation Buckeye” here in Columbus, is both a continuation and a serious escalation of the bipartisan targeting of all immigrants and refugees – with and without documentation. While this policy of state xenophobia has especially characterized the last two decades, from President Obama’s role as the “Deporter-in-Chief” to President Trump’s openly fascist policies of mass deportation and attacks on birthright citizenship, it is a long-standing policy of the American ruling class. From the Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882 to the Laken Riley Act of 2025, the scapegoating of immigrants and refugees has continually served to turn working people against each other, obscure our shared interests in organizing together, and deflect our class anger from where it belongs: the capitalist class that exploits us all. As socialists, we categorically reject these transparent attempts to divide us from our neighbors. Representative Ilhan Omar continues to be one of the most principled fighters against imperialism and fascism in American politics, and her refusal to be silenced in the face of mounting attacks is an inspiration to all of us. Columbus DSA expresses our full and unequivocal solidarity with Rep. Omar, and we encourage everyone to share her asks for support in this fight.
